chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
You will not find an ignorant person but at one extreme or the other.
ai.seo_question: How does ignorance manifest according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) observes that ignorance (jahil) inevitably manifests as an imbalance, either through excessive negligence (mufrit) or excessive exaggeration (mufarrit). This insight, drawn from Sharif al-Radi's *Nahj al-Balagha*, reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on *wasatiyyah* (moderation) as the hallmark of true knowledge, where the ignorant fail to calibrate their actions and beliefs correctly.
